bio.short: DJ Play (Dawaun Lucas) is a wedding and corporate event DJ and MC from Compton, mixing since 2008. Open format music for every generation and a polished MC, across Los Angeles and Orange County.
long: DJ Play is Dawaun Lucas, a DJ and MC from Compton who has been mixing since 2008. He's open format, so a set can move from golden-era hip-hop to the funk that came before it, then through R&B, throwbacks and today's hits. Every generation in the room hears a song they know.

He works the mic as well as the decks. At a wedding that means a processional that lands, a grand entrance with energy, and toasts that run smoothly. At a corporate event it means background music while people mingle, clean handoffs between speeches and dancing, and an MC who represents your brand well.

For more than 15 years he has played weddings, corporate events and galas, private parties, church celebrations and community gatherings across Los Angeles. Send your must-play and do-not-play lists ahead of time, and he keeps it clean whenever the room calls for it.

faq.a: Yes. The Signature package covers ceremony or cocktail hour sound plus the reception, and Elite covers all three.

faq.q: Will you work with our planner and venue?
faq.a: Yes. DJ Play coordinates with your planner, venue, photographer, videographer and catering team so the timeline stays on track.

faq.q: Can you handle speeches and announcements?
faq.a: Yes. DJ Play MCs, and wireless microphones are included with larger packages, with extra pairs available as an add-on.

faq.q: Can you keep the music clean?
faq.a: Yes. Music stays clean on request for corporate, church and family events.
Yes. Send your must-play and do-not-play lists before the event. Guests can also send requests live from their phones.
Yes. DJ Play covers Los Angeles, Long Beach, Orange County, Hollywood, Beverly Hills and beyond. Travel fees may apply, and your quote has no hidden costs.

faq.q: What if something goes wrong with the equipment?
faq.a: DJ Play arrives with professional-grade sound and always brings backup gear.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: 4 to 6 weeks ahead is best, and earlier for weddings. Last-minute dates are sometimes available, so ask.

faq.q: How do I lock in my date?
faq.a: Send a booking request and you'll hear back within 24 hours. A signed contract and deposit secure the date.
